answers_to_the_seven_required_questions.3_what_REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_means: CONTEXT-DEPENDENT in object, CONSTANT in force. The token forces the slot to carry an exact value. The _AND_BASIS / _AND_CONFIG / _AND_REASON suffixes are the pre-launch invariants that must accompany the runtime count.
